feedback: The proposal cleanly satisfies all listed gates. Its target remains exactly the locally defined checksum-selected participant, without imposing an external role or additional success condition.

findings.detail: The conservation-workshop artifact trail, handling records, access logs, tool records, and environmental readings fit workshop provenance naturally.
The premise states the locally defined ledger mechanism and identifies the checksum criterion as the complete success condition.
Tracing a damaged ceremonial object through intake, imaging, treatment, stabilization, and quarantine is a coherent workshop-review scenario.
No participant name, role, seniority, appearance order, or ordinary custody inference is presented as a shortcut to the target.
The proposal explicitly requires relational, temporal, causal, spatial, sequence, and protocol statuses to be combined in order under the local iterated modular checksum.
The premise centers on provenance review and evidence-ledger evaluation across workshop rooms, rather than an enclosed-crime or locked-room setup.
findings.gate: low resemblance to a stock locked-room mystery
